messages:
Alex C: Heads-up — our sample-app in JSON mode is returning double-encoded tool_call payloads when the auth retry kicks in. Repro steps below.

Alex C: Repro (node sdk v0.14.1):
```
# payload we send
{
  "tool_call": "{\"action\":\"upsert\",\"payload\":{\"id\":123}}"
}
```

Maya R: I can repro. Seems to only happen if the request gets a 401 and the SDK does a token refresh+retry. Python SDK (v0.29.0) doesn't show this. :eyes:

Sam (SDK): Can you paste the SDK logs around the retry? my hunch is the retry middleware is stringifying an already-serialized body.

Alex C: Logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-23T15:02:10Z] serializer: serialized body -> string
[2026-03-23T15:02:11Z] http: 401 Unauthorized
[2026-03-23T15:02:12Z] auth: refreshed token
[2026-03-23T15:02:12Z] retry: re-sending request (attempt 2)
[2026-03-23T15:02:12Z] serializer: serialized body -> string
```

Sam (SDK): Yup that's the bug. Retry runs after serializer and calls the same serialization step again, so the inner JSON gets escaped twice. We'll need to either make serialization idempotent or ensure retry uses the already-parsed body. I'll open a PR today.

Jules: Quick thought — could we add a lightweight SDK helper like `jsonMode({idempotent: true})` so callers can opt into a serializer that detects already-serialized values? Might avoid a breaking change.

Sam (SDK): Good idea. I'll prototype an idempotent encoder (checks for leading/trailing quotes + valid escaped JSON) and a short-term env flag `SDK_RETRY_PRESERVE_BODY=true`. Workaround for folks now: pin to Python SDK or disable automatic retry in Node.

ci-bot: test run triggered -> https://ci.internal/redwood/PR-4823 (unit tests + integration, will run against node v0.14.1 repro).

Alex C: Thanks — will try the env flag and report back. If PR lands we should add a tiny migration note in the changelog and an example in sample-apps. :thumbsup:
